name: Sam NPU — REVIEW50 host-network candidate
precision: INT8 x INT8 -> INT32 accumulation -> requant -> INT8
control_path: PS7 M_AXI_GP0 -> AXI-Lite -> NPU, base 0x43C00000 / 64 KiB
data_path: DDR3 <-> PS7 S_AXI_HP0 <-> AXI DMA <-> AXI-Stream <-> NPU
network_path: GEM0 over EMIO/MII -> EBAZ4205 onboard Ethernet PHY -> Linux TCP server
source_validation: Kernel module compiled with W=1 against Linux 6.8.0-31 x86-64 headers; actual ARM/PetaLinux build and runtime are unverified
status: 50/50 directed host checks and 55/55 Icarus RTL regressions PASS. Hardware acceptance remains open.

known_user_baseline.old_xsim_summary: PASS=20 FAIL=0 from pre-hardened summary logic

important_limits: No Vivado/XSim execution here. Icarus functional simulation passed; routed timing and board operation are unverified.
Exact external MII I/O delays require PHY/board timing validation
Optional U18 PHY clock must only be enabled on board variants that require PL-supplied 25 MHz
MatMul/Dense supports per-output-column INT32 bias via stream preamble; arbitrary per-element MxN bias is not exposed
Real Ethernet link, DMA traffic and inference must be verified on the physical EBAZ4205
Network MatMul replies are conventional row-major; hardware DMA output is compact tile-major and is reordered by the server
Streaming Conv is rejected if a single output exceeds the safe INT32 worst-case MAC accumulation bound (131071 samples)
Low-RAM defaults: VIVADO_JOBS=1 and XSIM_MT_LEVEL=off; increase only on a machine with more memory
No-Y3 PHY clock profile requires R1485 bridged from FPGA U18 to IP101GA pin 47; physical link must be confirmed on the actual PCB.
Production Conv2D uses host/ARM spatial-window lowering plus PL streaming INT8 MAC; legacy memory-address Conv2D scheduler modules are not reachable from npu_bd_top.
The SNPU v2 package is a validated intermediate weight/layer format; this release does not provide a complete on-board graph runtime that executes arbitrary .snpu files end-to-end.
compiler_safety: Strict INT8/INT32 range and shape/count validation; ONNX converter refuses silent floating-point-to-INT8 casts
extra_validation: pthread-backed DMA function tests with ASan/UBSan
11 C socketpair requests and Conv accumulation-length boundaries
Tcl API mocks for DMA/reset/IRQ properties

ethernet_clock_profiles.default: Onboard Y3/25 MHz oscillator assumed; U18 is not driven.
ethernet_clock_profiles.no_y3: Use scripts/build_ebaz4205_no_y3.sh after confirming R1485 is bridged; PS FCLK1=25 MHz is routed to U18/IP101GA pin 47.
ethernet_clock_profiles.hardware_gate: R1485 physical bridge and no-Y3 condition are not software-verifiable; confirm on the actual PCB before enabling the profile.
